desc:
⚔️ Build the ultimate Shadow Army! Click to gain power, watch your shadows grow behind you, and raise fallen bosses to fight at your side!

🖱️ Click to gain +1 Shadow Power!
👥 Grow your shadow army, stronger with every click!
🗡️ Unlock epic weapons, and your shadows wield them too!
💀 Defeat bosses and raise them as Elite Shadows!
🏆 Clear stages to earn Wins and climb the leaderboards!
🔥 Unlock auras for powerful boosts!
💪 Train to gain power even faster!
🔄 Rebirth to become even stronger!
🌍 Conquer new worlds, from the Forest to the Sun Kingdom!
🎁 Claim daily rewards, complete quests and earn while offline!
🎁 CODES: RESTART, WORLD9, TOWER
👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to support future updates!
